text: Give me three different logo options for my cycling club, Moss & Mile. Simple green and black on white, each with the name and a small symbol. Your call on the symbols, but make them genuinely different ideas. Three separate square images please, not a collage. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?
